epoch: expectedEpoch and reply epoch are the current outboxOpen proofEpoch, checked at execution; they are distinct from workspaceEpoch. Refresh outboxOpen after canonical reads before confirm-base.

pair.physicalName: logicalName for base; logicalName + -- + ref for profile

catalog.cursor: null or native-issued opaque v1 hex token scoped to current private profile, proofEpoch and page offset; reject arbitrary/stale/cross-profile cursor
catalog.discovery: Current pair, BASE and older pairs with the SAME actor prefix derived exclusively from actual native grant (origin/workspace/member), matching existing NativeRecovery authority. Persist native-derived actor in an indexed registry. Bounded metadata query only; no other-actor locations, old profile IDs, private parent hashes, business bodies or DB enumeration.
catalog.unresolved: BASE is always true because native location metadata never certifies its mixed bytes; current profile pair is false only as location metadata, never a business readiness or settlement assertion.
catalog.sourceSafety: Recovery location is not byte provenance or receipt acceptance. Never-staged raw IDB bytes remain explicitly unconfirmed, cannot auto-hydrate/promote/SEND. Mixed BASE retains row-level actor opacity and existing resource authority; no whole-store cross-actor export. Native accepted bytes require existing exact receipt/source-CAS/actor/resource checks.
catalog.ordering: Stable native metadata order with current pair first, distinct BASE second, then distinct older sameactor pairs. Pagination native-issued opaque cursor bound actual profile, proofEpoch and position; reject stale/forged/crossactor tokens. Default20/max100 entries per response, no all-profile body traversal.

resolve: Unassigned profile receives BASE candidate only when BASE unassigned. If BASE pinned to another private profile, atomically allocate this actual profile a random opaque profile pair. Failed candidate resolution is not an exclusive reader reservation.
confirm-base: Require current verified private profile/incarnation, current proofEpoch and existing online OR sealed cached-private read/append readiness including TTL/actor checks. Offline needsFloor may keep SEND blocked; a location commit never clears needsFloor/accountNeedsReconcile, advances authority or extends TTL. Atomically immutable BASE reader; no overwrite of another reader/separate assignment. Same assignment idempotent only after current identity/epoch/readiness recheck.
separate: Only current unassigned BASE candidate; atomically assign a separate random opaque pair, preserve BASE bytes. Idempotent repeated lookup/action can return existing separate current location; never select a renderer ref.
scope: Scoped bridge validates and removes workspaceEpoch before engine, adds to reply. No unknown engine or reply fields. Legacy may keep old base initialization; scoped requires mirrorVersion1.
accountScope: Mirror API requires actual account-scoped native identity/account seal; reject legacy mirror calls. Legacy JS retains BASE behavior.

baseDispositionSemantics.candidate: current pair BASE and singleton BASE has no confirmed reader
baseDispositionSemantics.current: current pair BASE and singleton BASE reader matches actual profile
baseDispositionSemantics.preserved: current pair profile and singleton BASE has a confirmed reader
baseDispositionSemantics.unresolved: current pair profile and singleton BASE has no confirmed reader

privateIncarnation: Lookup/assignment derives actual private session/parent incarnation in addition to public profile P. Same public P with different native session_ref/parent must allocate distinct location or fail closed; never adopt old pair/receipts. Test forced collision even if normal child binding changes P.
